# The test262 tests that are not run, one path per line, each with the reason in a comment above
# it. A skipped test still runs, and the test suite fails when it passes, so that its line is
# removed.

# The test expects the links of the IANA time zone database 2024b to 2026c from CST6CDT, EST5EDT,
# MST7MDT and PST8PDT to America/Chicago, America/New_York, America/Denver and
# America/Los_Angeles. Since 2026d these are zones again, "reverting to 2024a behavior", and the
# test is stale. Remove this line when test262 updates the test.
test/intl402/Temporal/ZonedDateTime/links.js

# The tests expect Date.parse to accept formats that the specification leaves to the
# implementation, such as 1997-3-8 1:1:1 and the two-digit year of 3/8/97.
test/staging/sm/Date/non-iso.js
test/staging/sm/Date/two-digit-years.js

# The test expects Math.sinh to be as precise as fdlibm's, while the specification leaves the
# precision to the implementation.
test/staging/sm/Math/sinh-approx.js

# The tests expect a function named arguments that is declared in a block to replace the
# arguments object, as in SpiderMonkey. The specification does not hoist it over the arguments
# object, as test/annexB/language/function-code/block-decl-func-skip-arguments.js checks.
test/staging/sm/lexical-environment/block-scoped-functions-annex-b-arguments.js
test/staging/sm/regress/regress-602621.js
